# Must-Have WoW Classic Addons in 2026

* Date 1/13/2025
* Last Updated: 1/6/2026 7:11:11 AM
* 4241 views
* Read time: 8 min.
* Author: Zaaid el-Greiss

**Addons** have been a core part of World of Warcraft since its early days: it’s special easy-to-install software that helps players customize and enhance their gameplay.

**In WoW Classic** , addons are especially valuable for optimizing your UI, tracking quests, managing inventory, and even improving performance in WoW raids and PvP. With Classic content designed to embrace nostalgia, these tools bring modern convenience to a retro experience, and allow you to enjoy the old-school versions of the game to the fullest.

_Check our **WoW Addons guide**_ if you don’t know how to install, update, and delete them.
**In this guide** , we’ll cover the best addons for every aspect of WoW Classic , from leveling and questing to PvE and PvP combat and auction house management. For 100% sure, these addons will help you explore Azeroth with ease.

**Let’s start!**

## Rested XP Classic Guide

The **RestedXP addon** is a powerful leveling guide designed specifically for **World of Warcraft Classic** and other expansions (if needed, you can use it for WoW The War Within too). Created by top speedrunners, this addon helps players optimize their leveling experience by providing step-by-step routes tailored to each class.

**How It Works:** RestedXP analyzes your character’s level and provides the most efficient leveling route, including which quests to complete and in what order.

**The RestedXP addon** simplifies leveling, ensures efficient progress, and helps players achieve their goals in Azeroth faster.

...

## Leatrix Maps

**Leatrix Maps** is a popular addon for World of Warcraft Classic that enhances your map functionality. It’s especially useful in Vanilla (20th Anniversary, SoD, Hardcore) but works across various game versions. This addon provides several features aimed at improving navigation and exploration, including:

* **Unexplored Areas Visibility** : See all areas in a zone, even those you haven’t discovered yet.
* **Zone-wide Map Display:** View the full zone map without restrictions, making navigation easier.
* **Customizable Settings** : Adjust map transparency, scaling, and other elements to suit your preferences.

## Classic Cast Bars

**Classic Castbars** is a WoW addon designed to provide customizable cast bars for players in both Classic and Retail versions of the game. It enhances the default cast bar system with additional features, making it especially useful for PvP and PvE content.

**How It Works:**
* **Custom Cast Bars** : Displays detailed cast bars for your target, party members, and nameplates.
* **Interrupt Alerts** : Tracks interruptible and uninterruptible casts with visual indicators.
* **School Lockout Notifications:** Alerts you when certain schools of magic are locked out.
* **Channel Tracking** : Supports tracking of channel-based abilities.
* **Customization Options** : Type /castbar in-game to adjust settings, including appearance and behavior.
* **In Classic Era 1.15.0** and later, Blizzard has integrated cast bar features into the default interface, so this addon may not be necessary for basic cast bar functionality. However, it remains valuable for players seeking advanced customizations.

## Rune Reminder (WoW Classic SoD)

**Rune Reminder** is a versatile World of Warcraft addon tailored for the Season of Discovery. It streamlines rune management by offering a user-friendly interface and automation features that enhance gameplay.

**How It Works:**
* **Rune Tracking** : Displays all learned and engraved runes for easy reference.
* **Quick Swap Widget** : Allows seamless rune switching without using the character window.
* **Rune Sets:** Save and load entire rune configurations. This feature auto-queues runes, requiring only one click per rune update.
* **Notifications** : Alerts you when a rune is removed or changed, with an option for one-click re-application.
* **Customizable Display:** Adjust widget size, location, and style to fit your UI preferences.
* **Additional Features** : Includes cooldown timers, Masque skin support, and options for splitting rune displays into rows or columns.

## GatherMate2 Classic

GatherMate2 Classic is a World of Warcraft addon designed to assist players with gathering professions such as Herbalism, Mining, Skinning, and Fishing. It tracks resource nodes, treasures, and other collectibles, displaying their locations on the **World Map** and **Minimap** for easy navigation.

**How It Works:**
* **Node Tracking:** Automatically records the locations of herbs, ores, fishing pools, treasures, and more as you gather them.
* **Map Integration:** Displays gathered data on the World Map and Minimap with icons representing the resource type.
* **Pre-Filled Data:** Includes a pre-filled database via the GatherMate2\_Data Wowhead Classic module, allowing you to import known resource locations instantly.
* **Range Notifications** : Highlights nodes on your Minimap as you come into range, helping you decide whether to investigate.
* **Guild Data Sharing** : Share gathered node data with guild members using the GatherMate\_Sharing feature.

**Key Features:**

* Supports all gathering professions (Herbalism, Skinning, Mining, Fishing) and additional collectibles like treasures and gas clouds.
* Routes support for optimized gathering paths.
* Easy configuration via the /gathermate command or the in-game interface options.

## Rarescanner
**RareScanner** is a World of Warcraft addon designed to help players track rare NPCs, treasures, and events. It provides real-time alerts and detailed map integration, making it easier to find valuable loot and engage with world content.

**How It Works:**

* **Alerts** :
  
    + Displays a notification button when a rare NPC, treasure, or event is nearby.
    + Shows details like the entity’s name, loot, and a miniature (for NPCs).
* **Map Integration** :
  
    + Marks rare NPCs, treasures, and events on the World Map with icons.
    + Hover over icons for additional information in tooltips.
    + Highlights entities that grant faction reputation when a faction is selected in Dragonflight zones.
* **Loot and NPC Explorer** : Easily find rare NPCs or treasures that drop specific mounts, pets, or other valuable items.
* **Custom NPC Tracking:** Add any NPC, rare or not, for custom alerts.
* **Filtering Options:** You can configure the addon to track only specific entities or categories.

## Questie

**Questie** is a must-have addon for World of Warcraft, especially for players in **Classic** and **Cataclysm Classic** versions. It enhances the questing experience by adding extra information to your map and interface: it allows you to find and complete WoW quests faster.

**How It Works:**

* **Map Integration:**
  
    + Displays quest start points, objectives, and turn-in locations on your map.
    + Includes notes for quest givers and objectives.
* **Improved Quest Tracker:**
  
    + Automatically tracks quests when accepted.
    + Expands the tracker to show up to 20 quests instead of the default 5.
    + Offers additional options like focusing on quests or pointing arrows to objectives (requires TomTom addon).
* **Tooltips** :
  
    + Shows detailed quest information when hovering over map icons or NPCs.
+ Displays extra data, such as quest XP, when holding Shift.
* **Quest Communication:** Displays party members’ quest progress in tooltips (requires all party members to use Questie).
* **Journey Log** : Records your progress through the “My Journey” feature, showing completed and available quests by zone.

## Details! Damage Meter

**Details! Damage Meter** is a highly customizable and reliable combat analysis addon for **World of Warcraft Classic** . It tracks damage, healing, and other metrics in real-time, offering must-have insights for players during PvE and PvP encounters.

**How It Works** :

* **Accurate Data Tracking** :
  
    + Consistently reads combat logs to provide precise damage, healing, and other performance metrics.
    + Ensures compatibility with ranking sites like WarcraftLogs.
* **Custom Displays** :
  
    + Build personalized displays using the Details! API.
    + Access a variety of pre-built views for specific needs.
* **Raid Tools:**

...

**Summing up** , by using the above-mentioned WoW Classic add-ons, you can optimize your performance, simplify grindy tasks, and explore Classic Azeroth in a much more enjoyable way. Installing and updating them is simple, and their benefits are immediate, whether you’re a casual player or a dedicated raider. Explore the best addons mentioned in this guide, and make your WoW Classic journey more engaging and rewarding.

**Keep in mind** that there are way more amazing WoW Classic add-ons available for download on Curseforge. Make sure to check them.

**Happy adventuring!**

Discord Calendar Bot

# Discord calendar bot for events, RSVPs, reminders, and Google Calendar digests

Soren turns your Discord server into a working community calendar with slash-command event creation, live RSVP buttons, recurring schedules, waitlists, reminders, and optional Google Calendar integrations.

[Add Soren to Discord](https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1423474696783138839&permissions=17929878105152&integration_type=0&scope=bot) Read the setup guide [Vote on Top.gg](https://top.gg/bot/1423474696783138839/vote)

Why Soren

## A Discord event calendar built for active communities

Most servers need more than a static calendar link. Soren keeps the entire event workflow inside Discord so members can discover, RSVP, get reminded, and show up without leaving the server.

📅

#### Calendar-style event management in Discord
Create events with `/newevent` , publish them to any channel, add descriptions, start and end times, timezone support, notify roles, recurrence, RSVP limits, and cutoff times.

✅

#### Live RSVP buttons and attendee lists

Members click Accept, Tentative, or Decline directly on the event embed. Soren updates attendee lists in real time and lets each member check their own upcoming events with `/myevents` .

⏰

#### Discord event reminders that survive restarts

Schedule multiple reminders per event and ping the right roles before start time. Reminder state is stored in the database, so planned notices remain reliable after bot restarts.

🔁

#### Recurring Discord events

Run weekly raids, monthly meetings, daily sessions, bi-weekly events, or custom recurrence intervals. Soren advances recurring events automatically and posts each new occurrence.

🗓️

#### Google Calendar and ICS support
Connect Google Calendar digest summaries and reminders to channels, then export upcoming Discord events as an `.ics` file for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, and Outlook.

📋

#### Waitlists, cutoff times, and discussion threads

Cap accepted RSVPs, automatically queue overflow signups, close RSVPs after a deadline, and keep event-specific planning in dedicated Discord threads.

Use Cases

## Made for Discord servers that run on schedules

Soren fits gaming clans, guilds, community groups, creator communities, study groups, project teams, and any server where people need to coordinate around real times.

#### Gaming clans and guilds

Schedule raids, scrims, practice nights, tournaments, and recurring weekly sessions with RSVP caps and reminders.

#### Community servers

Plan watch parties, workshops, meetings, voice events, office hours, and member-led meetups from one Discord calendar bot.

#### Teams and clubs
Keep volunteer shifts, project calls, club meetings, and shared calendars visible inside the channels members already use.

FAQ

## Discord calendar bot questions

What is a Discord calendar bot? ▾

A Discord calendar bot lets a server create, publish, remind, and manage events directly in Discord channels. Soren adds RSVP buttons, recurrence, role reminders, Google Calendar digests, waitlists, and event exports.

Can Soren connect Google Calendar to Discord? ▾

Yes. Soren can connect Google Calendar integrations, post weekly digest summaries and reminders into Discord channels, and export upcoming Discord events as calendar files.

Does Soren support recurring events? ▾

Yes. Soren supports daily, weekly, bi-weekly, bi-monthly, monthly, and custom recurring Discord events.

How fast can I set it up? ▾

Most servers can add Soren, run `/setup` , assign an Event Creator role, and publish the first event in a few minutes.

## README.md

# SoftRes

### A SoftReservation addon for WoW Classic.

## Who made SoftRes and why?

**SoftRes** is made by Mikael "Snits" Fridh. (Snits-NoggenfoggerEU)  
This is my first addon (well second, since I first made **SoftRes** then re-wrote it due to many bugs)

When I joined the guild _OMEGA_ on NoggenfoggerEU, I had no prior experience in raiding.
The first ZG run I joined, I noticed how messy everything was and all players had to keep track on their own stuff and the ML had to check lists and stuff.
I decided to create an addon to help with that. A **SoftRes** run should go smoothly, wether it's PUG or guild.

## Thanks to:

Thanks to _OMEGA_ for supporting me in the creation of **SoftRes** and testing it on our Guild-Runs.
Extra shoutout to Vadfangördu, Velina and everyone who has whispered me while the addon was used.

## What is SoftRes?

**SoftRes** is an addon, that helps the ML keep track of what people have **SoftRes** erved and will help with:

* **SoftRes** ervations of items and announcing elegible "rollers" on item-drops.
* Announcement of items and rolls.
* Keeps track of who has the highest roll.
* Will count roll-penalties (if configured)
* **SoftRes** loot rules are the rules that we use in _OMEGA_ when doing our PUGs and Guild runs, with **SoftRes** ervations.

...

\* Don't forget to put ML back again before bosses ... _cough_  
\* There is a "Check Box" up in the top-right corner which will show checked if ML is on, and unchecked if not.  
\* If you are the Raid Leader, you can press that check-box to switch between "Master Loot" and "Group Loot".  
\* There is a 0.5 second delay on the update so it can seem a bit laggy, but that's intentional.

## What's so good about SoftRes?

With **SoftRes** , _only the Master Looter needs to have the addon._

* Everything is done so that everyone can see.
* It announces winners and who has **SoftRes** erved what item when it drops.
* No more Google sheets.

## What's bad about SoftRes?

**SoftRes** assumes that you can link an item in chat.  
But really? Who doesn't have an addon that shows drops in dungeons?

## Wait! It announces and writes in chat and stuff. Doesn't that get messy?

There will be some spamming in chat, yes.
But that would happen even without **SoftRes** AND the ML would have to do it manually.  
**SoftRes** uses a library called "ChatThrottle" to make sure that the spams are kept in an acceptable pace.  
\* The user will NOT be thrown out of the game for spamming.  
**SoftRes** uses another library called "AceTimers" for handling the timers.

## How do you actually use **SoftRes** ?

As stated, only the ML needs the addon (which makes it perfect for pugs.)
Step-by-step:

1. Writing /softres show, will bring up the addon.
2. The ML will create a new list.
   
    1. **SoftRes** will automatically fill the **SoftRes** ervations list with all the player in the raid (or party if 5-man).
3. The ML will go through the configurations and make sure they are as he wants them, or what's agreed upon.
   
    1. You can configure loot-timers, loot-penalties..
    2. There is an extra box for custom information.
          
        1. I.e. "Ony-Head is reserved for guild."
        2. I.e.
"Need on all coins and bijous."
4. He will then announce the rules.
   
    1. **SoftRes** will post them in /raid.
    2. **SoftRes** will also, at this stage, start the scanner of **SoftRes** ervations.
5. Everyone in the raid will link the item they want to reserve.
   
    1. Yes, it has to be an item-link.
    2. Yes, **SoftRes** assumes that you have an addon or something that can put item-links in chat.
6. When everyone have made their **SoftRes** reservations, the ML will close the scanner.
7. Now you play as normal.
8. When the ML loot a mob and there are items with the configured itemrarity or higher in the lootlist, he will have to go through some steps.
   
    1. First the ML press "Prepare Item".
          
        1. What this does is that it will take the first item in the lootlist and prepare it for rolls.
        2. **Big note** . This ONLY _prepares_ the item for rolls, nothing else.
